headline: Attacks that pose as Claude and ChatGPT tools are surging and putting software developers at risk, according to Dark Reading.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: headline only, so the claim is unverified.
importance_line: Software developers who download AI tools are the people at risk, then the companies whose code and credentials they handle, but without the article we cannot say who counted the attacks or how.
summary: Dark Reading reports that attacks using fake versions of Claude and ChatGPT are surging and putting software developers at risk.
notes: Dark Reading blocked (403); no other outlet with text found. Softonic headline of 17 Oct gives a count of 1,258 attacks in six months; not used because unverified.
